notes: Most hits are other places named York (New York, York Mills in Toronto, the York River in Virginia, York Gate in Broadstairs, Canaletto’s York Water Gate in London) or Kirkstall Abbey near Leeds; all skipped. #3 is a smaller copy of #2. #1 (Braun and Hogenberg vol. 6) shows York only as a small street plan on a four-subject sheet. #25 was uploaded in 2015 but is categorized as taken in January 2009, so dated 2009. #15 (Micklegate Bar photochrom) is a single-gate alternative for P4.
